items.title: Tyreek Hill: Still rehabbing, no signing imminent
items.description: Hill's (knee) agent, Drew Rosenhaus, said Wednesday that he remains in contact with multiple teams, but "nothing is imminent" with regard to his client potentially finalizing a deal, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports. "He's continuing his rehab

items.title: Baker Mayfield: Likely to remain out Week 6
items.description:
Mayfield (thumb) "might do some stuff in practice this week" but appears unlikely to play Sunday against the Steelers, Mike Garafolo of NFL Network reports.

items.title: Lamar Jackson: Could still return Sunday
items.description:
Jackson (ankle) "has a realistic chance" to return to action Sunday against the Browns, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.

items.title: Ja'Kobi Lane: Could return in Week 6
items.description:
Lane (wrist) "is expected to return to practice" and per head coach Jesse Minter "has a shot" to play Sunday against the Browns, Mike Garafolo of NFL Network reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Myles Garrett: Not ready to return to practice
items.description:
Head coach Sean McVay told reporters Tuesday that Garrett (knee) will not return to practice this week and will not play against the Cardinals on Sunday, Cameron DaSilva of USA Today reports.
